description: Reviews, coverage, failures and queues (spec §12.5). Cost and duration are informational (PRD §13.2): no targets.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT day AS "time", caller AS "metric", sum(reviews)::float8 AS "reviews"
FROM review_daily_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(day) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT day AS "time", sum(incomplete)::float8 AS "incomplete", sum(degraded)::float8 AS "degraded"
FROM review_daily_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(day) AND caller = 'production' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Incomplete and degraded reviews per day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT day AS "time", avg(coverage_avg)::float8 AS "coverage"
FROM review_daily_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(day) AND caller = 'production' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT day AS "time", avg(cost_p50)::float8 AS "p50 USD", max(cost_p95)::float8 AS "p95 USD"
FROM review_daily_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(day) AND caller = 'production' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Cost per review, p50 and p95 (informational)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT day AS "time", max(dur_p95_s)::float8 AS "p95 seconds"
FROM review_daily_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(day) AND caller = 'production' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Zero-coverage, schema-error, timeout and error rates by rule, over production reviews in range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT rr.rule_id AS "Rule", rr.lane AS "Lane", count(*) AS "Runs",
  round(avg((rr.status = 'zero_coverage')::int), 3) AS "Zero coverage",
  round(avg((rr.status = 'schema_error')::int), 3) AS "Schema error",
  round(avg((rr.status = 'timeout')::int), 3) AS "Timeout",
  round(avg((rr.status = 'error')::int), 3) AS "Error",
  round(avg(rr.context_degraded::int), 3) AS "Context degraded"
FROM rule_runs rr JOIN reviews r ON r.id = rr.review_id
WHERE r.caller = 'production' AND $__timeFilter(r.started_at)
GROUP BY rr.rule_id, rr.lane ORDER BY avg((rr.status NOT IN ('ok', 'shed', 'deferred'))::int) DESC

panels.title: Rule runs that did not complete

panels.description: River jobs waiting or running, by queue (FR-D6: reviews queue per repo).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT queue AS "Queue", state AS "State", count(*) AS "Jobs",
  round(max(extract(epoch FROM now() - created_at)) / 60.0, 1) AS "Oldest (min)"
FROM river_job WHERE state IN ('available', 'scheduled', 'retryable', 'running', 'pending')
GROUP BY queue, state ORDER BY queue, state

panels.title: Queue depth

targets.rawSql:
SELECT args->>'repo' AS "Repo", count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'running') AS "Running",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE state IN ('available', 'scheduled', 'retryable', 'pending')) AS "Waiting",
  round(max(extract(epoch FROM now() - created_at)) FILTER (WHERE state <> 'running') / 60.0, 1) AS "Oldest waiting (min)"
FROM river_job WHERE kind = 'pr_review' AND state IN ('available', 'scheduled', 'retryable', 'running', 'pending')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY "Waiting" DESC

SELECT stage AS "Stage", provider AS "Provider", model AS "Model", count(*) AS "Calls",
  round(avg(failover::int), 3) AS "Failover rate", round(sum(coalesce(cost_usd, 0))::numeric, 2) AS "Cost USD",
  percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS "Latency p95 ms"
FROM model_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(at) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY "Calls" DESC
